core_change_summary.description: Added compile-time constant folding for pure function calls in runtime/vm/vm.go. Pure functions are registered in the type environment; constant values from let bindings are stored and used to evaluate calls at compile time. IR golden files for fun_call and fun_three_args are updated to reflect folded calls.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Golden file updates show the expected IR after constant folding; no other secondary changes.
